caption: The tool-use loop: the model only ever emits a structured request; your application validates it, runs the real function, and sends the result back as a new message, repeating until the model answers in text or the turn limit is reached.
alt: The application sends the conversation and the tool definitions to the model. The model returns either a text answer, which ends the loop, or a tool call naming a tool and its arguments. The application validates the arguments against the schema, executes the function, appends the result to the conversation, and calls the model again. A turn limit bounds the loop.
